title.narrative: Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA) Madagascar Build Project

description.narrative: Overall objective: The humanitarian system is strengthened to respond to multi-hazard threats through the implementation of early action protocols in Welthungerhilfe Madagascar areas of intervention.Specific Objective1: The project has identified and analyzed risks, to support the development of anticipatory mechanisms/tool and to be able to have access to anticipation funding in time ;Specific Objective2: Welthungerhilfe will ensure that a strategy for the progressive handover and institutionalization of the mechanism created during the project to the competent authorities in risk management and alert systems to ensure greater efficiency and sustainability of anticipation mechanism.

This project aims to establish community-based EAPs. The goal is to operationalize a multi-hazard anticipation mechanism covering major climate hazards in Anosy, Atsimo Andrefana, Atsimo Atsinanana. The proposed multi-hazard system will consider 3 main hazards including: cyclones/flood, and drought. WHH aims to build strong relationships and link to existing anticipation systems in the country. The organisation will go for further improvements of its existing drought model on and conceptualize an adapted triggering system for cyclone/flood based on the contexts and existing monitoring systems. To be more efficient in the implementation and response process, WHH will value more and more localized community work to be able to communicate and build efficiently local capacity for better community resilience and anticipated assistance.
